description: Pope Sixtus IV (or Xystus IV, Italian: Sisto IV; born Francesco della Rovere; (21 July 1414 – 12 August 1484) was head of the Catholic Church and leader of the Papal States from 9 August 1471 until his death in 1484. Sixtus IV's accomplishments as pope included the construction of the Sistine Chapel and the creation of the Vatican Library.
